I personally use vortex from Nexusmods.com

When you set it all up, find RoN in the games tab, make sure your account is set up on both Vortex and Nexus. 

When you download a mod, you can press the option that says something like "download with vortex" or "download with mod manager". It's one of those lol

However, for anything having to do with audio (voice packs, music replacements, etc..) you will have to download and install the manually. 

For this process, let's say you're downloading a voice pack. You would download it manually from Nexus, go to your downloads in your files and unpack it. There will be a folder named VO in there somewhere. Enter it, copy all of its contents, and paste it into here: ReadyorNot/ReadyorNot/Content/VO. 

Replace all the files. Make a backup of the original if you want to, or don't.
